summary: Switching a V's hairstyle in the Character panel, prepared ahead where possible, with the tile selected at once.

steps.does: The hair row is open; its visible choices and hover are session state.
Asks the host to prepare the visible choices ahead and asks for their pictures.
Prepares choices in priority order, pausing while the person's own request runs.
After a 0.4 s rest on a choice, preloads its parts into the pool.
The click shows the tile selected at once and commits the option key (a character step).
Changes with the V's hair key.
Asks for the new request, superseding its own older one.
Answers from a valid kept answer, or prepares the record.
Keeps every unchanged part and takes the preloaded hair from the pool.
Loads the rest and swaps the new set in.
Provides the new hair's dangle spec to motion.

demand: The scene showing the V; the open row for prefetch and pictures.

faults.when: The new choice couldn't be prepared; the V stays as shown, with Try again.
The installation can't honour a choice; it shows as a conflict in the V's view.

latency: Prepared and hovered: first frame under 200 ms (met today: 77–86 ms).
Prepared, new to the page: under 1 s (met: 0.26–0.91 s).
Never prepared: under 1 s typical with progress at once (0.34–2.3 s measured; over for three 4096² maps).
budget.memory: The part pool holds the previous V's parts until another V clears it.

invariants: The tile shows the choice selected in the same cycle as the click, and rolls back only on refusal.
Background prefetch never runs while the person's own request runs.
A superseded request never overwrites a newer one's result.
The view never mixes parts of two records.

x-friction.gap: Prefetch pauses, not aborts, for the person's request.
